name: gradient-zeus-miracle
title: Zeus Miracle
blurb: Purple to lavender gradient, soft vertical sweep.
description: A horizontal div with a linear gradient from deep purple to light lavender. CSS-only, no animation.
use_when: A soft, elegant background for a hero or section that evokes calm or luxury.
avoid_when: High-contrast interfaces; the pale lavender reads thin against light backgrounds.
a11y: Passive visual layer. No interactive content, no motion.
